name: Poetae Machinae
source:
A brilliant scientist invents a machine that can contain a human mind but the AI he made opposes him against the usage of machine.

[From [url=https://cemii.itch.io/poetae-machinae]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位杰出的科学家发明了一种可以容纳人类思维的机器，但他制造的人工智能却反对他使用机器。

[来自[url=https://cemii.itch.io/poetae-machinae]Itch.io[/url]]
